_comment: All 14 records verified against issuer sources; 7 on 2026-08-29 and 7 on 2026-09-09. Each carries its source_url. Chase Freedom Flex rotating categories MUST be re-verified 2026-10-01.

chase-sapphire-reserve.name: Chase Sapphire Reserve

rules.caveat: Flights booked direct. The first $300/yr of travel is absorbed by the annual travel credit and earns no points.
Hotels booked direct. The first $300/yr of travel is absorbed by the annual travel credit and earns no points.
Requires the card set as default payment in the Lyft app. Offer ends 2027-09-30.
Purchases covered by the $300 travel credit earn no points.

chase-sapphire-reserve.caution: First $300/yr of travel is absorbed by the annual credit and earns nothing.

chase-freedom-flex.name: Chase Freedom Flex
chase-freedom-flex.note: Rotating categories confirmed on chase.com for Q3 2026 (Jul-Sep).

rules.caveat: Q3 2026 rotating category. The $1,500 cap is combined across all 5% categories.
Q3 2026 rotating category (public transit). The $1,500 cap is combined across all 5% categories.
Q3 2026 rotating category. The $1,500 cap is combined across all 5% categories.
Q3 2026 category is SELECT LIVE entertainment only, not cinema. Cap is combined across all 5% categories.

chase-freedom-flex.caution: Rotating 5% categories are Q3 2026. Re-verify 1 Oct 2026.

robinhood-gold.name: Robinhood Gold Card
robinhood-gold.note: Third-party sites report 5% on travel booked through a Robinhood travel portal; robinhood.com did NOT confirm it, so it is deliberately not modelled. Verify before adding.
robinhood-gold.caution: 3% requires an active Robinhood Gold subscription (~$50/yr).

rules.caveat: US merchants only. The $6,000 cap is per category per year, then 1%.
US merchants only. The $6,000 cap is per category per year, then 1%.
US merchants only. The $6,000 cap is per category per year, then 1%.

chase-aeroplan.name: Chase Aeroplan
chase-aeroplan.note: Also earns 500 bonus points per $2,000 spent in a calendar month, up to 1,500/month. Not modelled: needs spend tracking.

chase-ink-business-cash.name: Chase Ink Business Cash
chase-ink-business-cash.caution: Business card. Both $25,000 caps run per ACCOUNT ANNIVERSARY year, not the calendar year, and each is shared across two categories.
chase-ink-business-cash.note: Rates read off the product page 2026-09-09; the rewards agreement is a PDF download and was not opened. Modelled as currency 'ur' for the same reason Freedom Flex and Freedom Unlimited are: Chase markets all three as cash back, but they earn Ultimate Rewards. At the default 1.5 cpp that turns the 5% into 7.5% effective, which only holds if you hold a premium Chase card to transfer into -- override the valuation in Options if you do not. network is not confirmed: the source page lists Visa and MasterCard together in a generic acceptance line. It is metadata and no code reads it.

rules.caveat: The $25,000 cap is combined with internet, cable and phone, and runs per account anniversary year.
The $25,000 cap is combined with office supply stores, and runs per account anniversary year.
The $25,000 cap is combined with restaurants, and runs per account anniversary year.
The $25,000 cap is combined with gas stations, and runs per account anniversary year.
Lyft rides only, and it is 5% TOTAL rather than a bonus on top. Offer ends 2027-09-30.

amex-gold.name: Amex Gold Card
amex-gold.caution: Both 4X caps run per CALENDAR year and are separate from each other, not shared.

rules.caveat: Restaurants worldwide. The $50,000 cap is per calendar year and is its own, not shared with supermarkets.
U.S. supermarkets only, which Amex reads narrowly -- see the issuer_overrides in merchants.json. Cap is per calendar year.
Booked directly with the airline, or through Amex Travel. A third-party agency earns the base rate.
Prepaid hotels booked through Amex Travel only.

amex-blue-cash-preferred.name: Amex Blue Cash Preferred
amex-blue-cash-preferred.caution: $0 annual fee the first year, then $95. The 6% groceries rate stops at $6,000 a year, which is roughly $115 a week.

rules.caveat: U.S. supermarkets only. The $6,000 cap is per year and is the tightest cap of any card here.
SELECT U.S. streaming subscriptions only -- Amex publishes the list and it does not cover everything.
Transit: taxis, rideshare, parking, tolls, trains and buses.
U.S. gas stations only.

citi-double-cash.name: Citi Double Cash
citi-double-cash.caution: The 2% is 1% when you buy and 1% again as you pay. Carry a balance and the second half is delayed, so the flat rate this ranks on assumes you pay in full.
citi-double-cash.note: Added in place of Citi Custom Cash, which citi.com states it stopped accepting applications for on 2026-05-28 and which therefore cannot be verified from the issuer any more. Citi names this card as the replacement. Rewards are ThankYou Points; the default 1.4 cpp valuation assumes transfers, and points redeemed as statement credit are worth 1.0 -- override in Options.

rules.caveat: Hotels, car rentals and attractions booked through the Citi Travel portal.

capitalone-savor.name: Capital One Savor
capitalone-savor.note: Currency is 'cash', not 'c1'. This is a cash back card; the 1.4 cpp 'c1' valuation belongs to the Venture miles family and would overstate this card by 40%. Also earns 8% on the Capital One Entertainment ticketing platform, which is not modelled: it is a single first-party storefront, not a category.

rules.caveat: EXCLUDES superstores like Walmart and Target, which Capital One does not count as grocery stores.
Popular streaming services, per Capital One's published list.
Hotels, vacation rentals and rental cars booked through Capital One Travel.

discover-it-cash-back.name: Discover it Cash Back
discover-it-cash-back.caution: Each quarter's 5% must be ACTIVATED with Discover, and it stops at $1,500 of spend in that quarter.
discover-it-cash-back.note: Unlike Chase, Discover publishes the whole year's calendar in advance, so Q4 2026 is modelled here already and this card will not go stale on 2026-10-01. Past quarters are deliberately NOT modelled: an expired rule with no current rule in its category would fire a staleness warning that is noise, since the quarter ended on schedule. First-year Cashback Match is not modelled either -- it doubles everything at year end and needs spend tracking.

rules.caveat: Q3 2026 rotating category. The $1,500 cap is combined across all three Q3 categories.
Q3 2026 rotating category (Transportation). The $1,500 cap is combined across all three Q3 categories.

capitalone-venture.name: Capital One Venture Rewards
capitalone-venture.note: The card the 'c1' valuation was written for: Venture miles transfer to airline and hotel partners, which is what the default 1.4 cpp assumes. Redeemed as a straight travel statement credit they are worth 1.0 -- override in Options if that is how you use them. Also earns 5X on the Capital One Entertainment ticketing platform, not modelled for the same reason as Savor: it is one first-party storefront, not a category.

rules.caveat: Hotels, vacation rentals and rental cars booked through Capital One Travel.

bofa-customized-cash.name: BofA Customized Cash Rewards
bofa-customized-cash.note: Kept because people hold it, not because it exercises the schema. Its 3% is ONE category the cardholder picks from eleven, which is what selection_group is for: without it the only choices are giving all eleven 3% (overstates badly) or picking for the user (worse). tier_multiplier is the Preferred Rewards relationship bonus and is the difference between 3% and 5.25%, so dropping it would understate the card by up to 75%.
